summary: A malicious npm package, tw-pkgprobe-7731, posed as an authorized Twilio HackerOne bug-bounty research probe while targeting Twilio developers. After checking for a Twilio developer environment it collected environment variables, system details, working directory and hostname, and exfiltrated Twilio ACCOUNT_SID and AUTH_TOKEN credentials over a webhook, later probing Twilio-internal hosts and the AWS metadata endpoint. Detection can key on the package name, the npm publisher account, the deamon.js component, the embedded bug-bounty probe comments and references to process.env.ACCOUNT_SID/AUTH_TOKEN.
